_readme.what_this_is: A blank intake template for the Banking PRD Generator. Replace every 'FILL IN' marker with your real project details, delete this _readme block (optional — the tool ignores it either way), save the file, and run the generator.
_readme.required_fields: Only productName, featureName, and author are required. Everything else is optional.
_readme.optional_fields: Any optional field/array you delete entirely falls back to the tool's built-in banking default (see README.md > Banking PRD Generator for what each default contains) — e.g. delete 'regulatoryRequirements' to fall back to the standard KYC/AML/PCI DSS/PSD2/GDPR/Basel III/SOX list, or delete 'glossary' to fall back to the standard banking glossary.
_readme.arrays: Arrays (things in [ ]) can have as many entries as you need — copy the { ... } block inside and edit it, or delete entries you don't need.
_readme.raci_key: RACI = R Responsible (does the work) / A Accountable (owns the outcome, usually one person) / C Consulted (gives input) / I Informed (kept in the loop).
_readme.acceptance_criteria_note: Write acceptance criteria as Given/When/Then — that's what makes them testable instead of vague.
_readme.priority_field: The top-level 'priority' field must be exactly one of: Critical, High, Medium, Low (it's pre-set to "High" — change it if needed). Epic/user-story priorities are free text and can be anything.

productName: FILL IN — the banking product/system this belongs to, e.g. "Digital Banking Platform" or "Corporate Internet Banking"
featureName: FILL IN — the feature/epic this PRD covers, e.g. "Instant Card Freeze & Unfreeze"
author: FILL IN — your full name
businessUnit: FILL IN — e.g. "Retail Banking", "Cards & Payments", "Digital Channels"
businessNeed: FILL IN — 2-4 sentences: what business problem does this feature solve, and why now?
businessObjectives: FILL IN — objective 1, e.g. 'Reduce average handling time for X by Y%.'
currentState: FILL IN — how is this need met today (manual process, branch visit, existing workaround)?
futureState: FILL IN — what will the experience look like once this is delivered?
inScope: FILL IN — what this feature explicitly includes
outOfScope: FILL IN — what this feature explicitly does NOT include
channelsAffected: FILL IN — e.g. Mobile Banking App, Internet/Online Banking, Branch/Teller, Contact Center/IVR
assumptions: FILL IN — something you're taking as true for planning purposes
constraints: FILL IN — a hard limit on the solution (technical, regulatory, budget, timeline)
dependencies: FILL IN — a system, team, or decision this feature depends on

regulatoryRequirements.regulation: FILL IN — e.g. 'KYC / Customer Due Diligence'
regulatoryRequirements.requirement: FILL IN — exactly what this feature must do to satisfy it

businessRules: FILL IN — a rule that governs how this feature must behave (eligibility, limits, exceptions)

epics.title: FILL IN — usually the same as featureName
epics.description: FILL IN — 1-2 sentences describing what this epic delivers and why

userStories.title: FILL IN — short story title, e.g. 'Freeze a card'

narrative.asA: FILL IN — the user type, e.g. 'authenticated customer'
narrative.iWant: FILL IN — what they want to do
narrative.soThat: FILL IN — why they want it

userStories.priority: FILL IN — Critical, High, Medium, or Low

acceptanceCriteria.then: FILL IN — the expected, testable result

items: FILL IN — or delete this whole array to use the tool's default Security/Performance/Availability/Auditability/Usability/Scalability NFRs

dataRequirements.description: FILL IN — what data, and why this feature needs it
dataRequirements.sensitivity: FILL IN — e.g. PII, PCI — Cardholder Data, Confidential

risks.risk: FILL IN — what could go wrong
risks.impact: FILL IN — High, Medium, or Low
risks.likelihood: FILL IN — High, Medium, or Low
risks.mitigation: FILL IN — how you'll reduce or handle it

glossary.term: FILL IN — a term specific to this feature that a reader might not know
glossary.definition: FILL IN — or delete this whole array to use the tool's built-in banking glossary (KYC, AML, PCI DSS, PSD2, SCA, SLA, RACI, NFR, BABOK)

elicitationTechniques: FILL IN — how you gathered these requirements, e.g. 'Stakeholder interviews with Compliance and Operations'
elicitationSources: FILL IN — who/what you consulted, e.g. 'Business Sponsor', 'Existing policy documentation'
